categories.main_business_segments: Range Resources Corporation is an independent natural gas, natural gas liquids (NGLs), and crude oil company engaged in exploration, development, and acquisition of natural gas and oil properties. The company operates as a single segment focused on the Marcellus Shale in Pennsylvania, with approximately 65% natural gas, 33% NGLs, and 2% crude oil and condensate in its proved reserves portfolio.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs horizontal drilling and hydraulic fracturing techniques as core technologies for natural gas and oil extraction. Key methods include advanced completion optimization, decline curve analysis, well logs, geologic mapping, seismic data interpretation, reservoir simulation modeling, and enhanced data analytics. The company utilizes electric hydraulic fracturing fleets and dual fuel drilling rigs to reduce emissions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Range Resources sells natural gas to utilities, marketing and midstream companies, and industrial users. NGLs are sold to petrochemical end users, marketers/traders (domestic and international), and natural gas processors. Oil and condensate are sold to crude oil processors, transporters, and refining and marketing companies. The company markets to a large number of customers in diverse markets including the Midwest, Gulf Coast, Southeast, Northeast, and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations are concentrated in the Appalachian region of the United States, specifically in the Marcellus Shale in Pennsylvania. Essentially 100% of proved reserves are located in Pennsylvania. The company maintains field offices in its operating areas and holds approximately 894,000 gross (783,000 net) acres under lease as of December 31, 2022.
categories.supply_chain_position: Range Resources operates in the midstream and downstream segments of the oil and gas supply chain. The company is responsible for exploration, development, and production of natural gas and oil. It depends on third-party gathering and transportation facilities, processing plants, and pipelines owned by others to move production from wellheads to market delivery points.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include environmental protection and worker safety, concentration in core operating areas, cost efficiency, maintaining a high-quality multi-year drilling inventory (over 3,300 proven and unproven locations), maintaining long-life reserves with low base decline rates, and marketing products to diverse customers. The company targets net-zero Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions by year-end 2025 and focuses on operational efficiencies and technology enhancements.
categories.revenue_model: Range Resources generates revenue primarily through the sale of natural gas, NGLs, and crude oil and condensate. Revenue is based on commodity prices (largely market-based), with prices negotiated based on index or spot prices, distance from wellhead to pipeline, commodity quality, and supply-demand conditions. The company uses commodity derivatives to hedge portions of future production and manage price volatility.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from major oil and gas companies and numerous independent operators in exploration, development, acquisitions, and production. Competitors include Antero Resources, Chesapeake Energy, CNX Resources, EQT Corporation, and others. Range's competitive advantages include its sizable acreage position in the Marcellus Shale, core area concentration providing economies of scale, experienced technical team, and focus on cost efficiency.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2022, Range Resources had 238.9 million shares outstanding and a market capitalization of approximately $5.98 billion (based on June 30, 2022 valuation). The company reported 2022 net income of $1.2 billion ($4.69 per diluted share) compared to $411.8 million ($1.61 per share) in 2021. Cash from operating activities was $1.9 billion in 2022, up 135% from 2021. Proved reserves increased 2% to 18.1 Tcfe with a reserve life index of approximately 22 years.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Range Resources emphasizes returns-focused development, operational efficiency, and cost control as key differentiators. The company highlights its large, high-quality multi-year drilling inventory in the Marcellus Shale, long-life reserve base with low decline rates, and ability to achieve competitive cost structures through operational expertise and scale. The company also emphasizes commitment to environmental protection, worker safety, and sustainable operations, including water recycling programs and emissions reduction initiatives.
